NFR-01.target: GET /v1/tasks/{id} p95 < 30ms and GET /v1/tasks?limit=50 p95 < 80ms at 10,000 rows; SQL statement count per list request constant

NFR-02.target: 0 shell=True/eval(/exec( hits; 0 string-built SQL; hash-only keys with hmac.compare_digest; deny-by-default CORS; bandit 0 HIGH 0 MEDIUM

NFR-03.target: explicit commit/rollback per request; no bare except or except Exception: pass; CancelledError re-raised; DB failure fail-closed 503; timeout child killed and reaped

NFR-04.target: every line matching the canonical secret pattern replaced with [REDACTED] before persistence/emission; DB URL never in logs, errors, or /v1/metrics

NFR-05.target: 100% public docstrings with [FR-XX]/[NFR-XX] citations; every route has OpenAPI summary and description

NFR-06.target: import-linter layers contract api > service > repository > models with config/errors independence; sqlalchemy imports confined to repository and migrations; lint-imports exit 0

NFR-07.target: all runtime deps pinned with == plus full transitive lock; every license in MIT/BSD-2-Clause/BSD-3-Clause/Apache-2.0/PSF allowlist; SBOM emitted at 08-config/SBOM.json

NFR-08.target: mutation score >= 70 over service/ and repository/ with the runtime-budget rationale recorded in harness_config.json

NFR-09.target: 0 skipped/xfailed/stub tests; every test has at least one assert; real SQLite migration round trip with no mocks; TRACEABILITY_MATRIX VERIFIED only after execution

NFR-10.target: integration line coverage >= 80 driven through httpx ASGITransport(app); status matrix 401/403/404/409/422/429/503, migration round trip, rate-limit recovery, graceful drain

NFR-11.target: project MI >= 80; per-function CC <= 10; file <= 400 lines; directory <= 15 files; handler <= 40 lines

NFR-12.target: make verify-system exit 0 after alembic upgrade head, full test suite, /healthz + /readyz smoke, downgrade base + upgrade head round trip; prints verify-system: PASS
